{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A refined knit top in a deep forest green, tunic-length cut, hex code #225533, soft wool blend with a subtle textured weave.
Tailored trousers in a matching charcoal heather, straight-leg silhouette to just below the ankle, hex code #364F4B, lightweight heavy cotton twill.
A structured blazer in classic black, single-breasted cut with notched lapels, hip-length hem, hex code #000000, fine gabardine wool.
Simple gold hoop earrings with a brushed finish.
A slim leather belt in chestnut brown, thin buckle, hex code #8B4513, smooth calfskin.
Ankle boots in polished oxblood leather, low block heel, pointed toe, hex code #702219, full-grain leather.

This outfit strikes a perfect balance between reverence and your desire to stand out during the church service. The deep forest green knit is rich and saturated enough to catch the daylight without being loud, while the matching charcoal trousers maintain a cohesive, polished silhouette suitable for gathering with family. The black blazer adds the necessary layer of modesty and structure required for religious settings, yet its sharp tailoring ensures you look intentional rather than uniform. Completing the look with warm oxblood boots and gold accessories introduces subtle flashes of color that align with your wish to express individuality without crossing into immodesty."}
